description: Single-Variable Fragility Analysis of Mainshock-Aftershock Sequences for Community Resilience Studies: Data and Code is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by John van de Lindt, Colorado State University (colostate.edu). This project presents a data-driven methodology for developing single-variable fragility functions to assess the seismic vulnerability of buildings subjected to mainshock-aftershock sequences. The study focuses on reinforced concrete (RC) and woodframe structures, capturing incremental damage accumulation from successive seismic events. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Seismic Vulnerability, Fragility Functions, Mainshock-Aftershock Sequences, Community Resilience, Seismic Risk Assessment, Structural Fragility Modeling. Published 2025-02-11. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
